milestones.title: F5 Reactors: kinetics and chemical equilibrium
milestones.summary: F5-C1 certified ideal-gas equilibrium extent constraints, B3 liquid package regions (UNIFAC original and Dortmund, ideal solution), and B3 part 2 thermally coupled regions (committed 74e7c15..effd992 after review). In a coupled region the package closure is the caloric closure, with the formation reference of the declaration anchor, and T = T(H, P, n_ref + N xi). Adiabatic isobaric liquid esterification and package-vapour (ideal-gas) reactions are verified against independent solutions. Index-one admission is gated by an outward-rounded Jacobian composition dg/dxi|_{H,P} = (dg/dn)N + R T^2 (dg/dT)(dg/dT)^T / C_p over the extent box crossed with the recorded temperature interval (a runtime check keeps T inside it), with certified C_p > 0 and bisection over extents and T. milestones.title: R11 SLE across a liquid-liquid gap
milestones.summary: A saturated liquid must also be stable: new `liquid_stability` (liquid tangent-plane distance from the liquid model's own ln gamma, Michelsen successive substitution from 2N starts, any N); `solubility_roots` returns every root with its stability, `solubility` returns the unique stable root, `liquidus_T` takes the highest root and requires a stable liquid, and `certify` reports `no_cumple` for an unstable liquid. Checked against an analytic Margules liquid (closed-form binodal x' = 0.1447941 for A = 2.5; the 275 K root 0.1659 is metastable and no longer returned) and a ternary regular solution (analytic Hessian). The S-L1-L2 monotectic is rejected with cause `liquid_liquid_instability` and not computed (capability gap). commits 3ef0e83..2f39369 on fase-a-adopcion. Independent A1 review 5 November 2026: confirmed closed.

milestones.title: R12 crystallization_T silent skips
milestones.summary: `crystallization_T` skips a present solid only when its liquidus lies below its own record's T_min (or its saturated liquid is unstable below the selected first-solid temperature); a liquidus above the window, below a clipped activity-model range, an undefined melting temperature or an instability at or above the selected T is re-raised as FueraDeAlcance naming the solid (`datos['solid']`, `datos['cause']`). Regression: three synthetic solids with an ideal liquid clipped to (200, 240) K, where the delivery returned C at 226.5 K instead of rejecting A (liquidus 268 K). commits 3ef0e83..2f39369 on fase-a-adopcion. milestones.title: R14 SLE input validation
